sections.title: Model overview and intended purpose
sections.text: The legacy credit default logistic regression (LR-R-001) estimates the probability that a credit-card customer defaults next month and is used in credit decisions. It is implemented in R and predicts default.payment.next.month.

rows.label: Dataset
rows.value: Default of Credit Card Clients (UCI Machine Learning Repository)

rows.label: Origin
rows.value: Credit-card clients in Taiwan, payment history April to September 2005

rows.label: Intended use here
rows.value: Public demonstration data only; not representative of a UK bank's current portfolio

sections.title: Algorithm and methodology
sections.text: The model is a logistic regression fitted with glm using a binomial family and logit link on 21 input features. ID, SEX and AGE are excluded from the predictors. Training uses a stratified 80% train / 20% test split, and a predicted probability above 0.35 is classed as default.

rows.label: Target variable
rows.value: default.payment.next.month

rows.label: Input features (21)
rows.value: LIMIT_BAL, EDUCATION, MARRIAGE, PAY_0, PAY_2, PAY_3, PAY_4, PAY_5, PAY_6, BILL_AMT1, BILL_AMT2, BILL_AMT3, BILL_AMT4, BILL_AMT5, BILL_AMT6, PAY_AMT1, PAY_AMT2, PAY_AMT3, PAY_AMT4, PAY_AMT5, PAY_AMT6

rows.label: Excluded columns
rows.value: ID, SEX, AGE

rows.label: Preprocessing
rows.value: Stratified train/test split on the target with random_state=42, Model reads the processed train and test CSV files

rows.label: Train/test split
rows.value: 80% train / 20% test

sections.title: Limitations and assumptions
sections.text: SEX and AGE are retained only for fairness review. No probability calibration step was found in the code. The business owner, change history and performance targets are not documented in the code, and the demonstration data is historical Taiwanese credit-card data.
